tools.name: fomc_minutes_latest
tools.description: The latest FOMC minutes release from the Board's monetary policy feed: which meeting they cover, the release date and the link. Useful for "are the Fed minutes out?" three weeks after each meeting. Returns the link, not a summary of the minutes, and only covers releases still in the feed. (cost: 1 c

tools.name: fed_monetary_policy_releases
tools.description: The Board's monetary policy press releases newest first (FOMC statements, minutes, projections, discount rate minutes), each labelled by type with its date and link. For news and briefing agents that need the official list rather than news coverage. Lists titles and links only, from the recent items

tools.name: fed_speeches_latest
tools.description: Latest speeches by Federal Reserve Board members (Chair, Vice Chairs, Governors) from the Board's speeches feed, optionally filtered by surname: speaker, title, date, venue and link. Tracks Fedspeak at its source. Board members only (not Reserve Bank presidents), recent items only, and no transcript

tools.name: fed_repo_operations_results
tools.description: Results of the Fed's most recent repo operations (the Standing Repo Facility): amounts banks submitted and the Fed accepted, split by collateral (Treasury, agency, mortgage-backed) with the offering rate. Straight from the New York Fed; take-up is the headline sign of month- and quarter-end funding

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "central-banks-rates" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fed_monetary_policy_releases · Public sink: fed_repo_operations_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fed_monetary_policy_releases · Public sink: fed_repo_operations_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
